integrity: An exact symbolic identity and a monotone adjacent-exchange argument prove the all-season claim. A separate exact-rational checker corroborates finite instances. No assertion of external audit, independent certification, stochastic persistence, or unseen literature inspection.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic, fixed and shared seasonal adult replacement fraction, positive recruitment ratios, finite-horizon final frequency. Complete 1981 and 1985 archival source texts inaccessible; broader permutation theorems remain a possible originality risk.
title: A universal finite-horizon ordering theorem for two-species recruitment lotteries
